about: Width-gate budgets per box variant (pipeline.md §Width gate). px = widest text in pixels (width table 0x4645B8 advances), bytes = hard byte cap, lines = lines per page. status: measured (with shot/evidence) or guess. Tables map script/<table>.json to a variant; a string shown on several screens takes the smallest budget. Rulers: build.py --marker --full turns every FE name into its id + W/M (8 px each) up to the variant's byte cap. Checked by tools/lint.py (in tools/check.py).

vars.about: {var:00} = player name (F9 00 reads 0x03001D54, 0x0804170C): 10-cell buffer, so 10 x 8 px until name entry is redrawn. {var:01}-{var:04} read the 20-byte piece buffers 0x030005C6/DA/EE/0x03000602 (jump table 0x08041748), which the code fills with item, part, weapon-kind, attack and part-slot names (strcpy 0x08040A4C / 0x08043294): the widest piece allowed is the var_piece budget (100 px), so lines are linted with each var at that width

dialogue.evidence: engine wraps words at pen x > 0xD0 (0x080414BA); marker --full: a 205 px line ends at x=221 inside the yellow box (inner edge ~x=224), work/qa/scenes_mfull/encyclopedia_entry + work/qa/enc_full_z.png; same box in home_1f (face), cutscene_01, parts_shop_detail description, field_help, items_owned
dialogue.notes: one word wider than 208 px wraps before it is drawn (lands on a third, invisible line). {var:00} (player name) on line 1 eats into that line

battle_message.evidence: robattle_attack (work/qa/scenes_m3): battle text in the same 208 px yellow box
battle_message.notes: lines are assembled from pieces (attack name + action + message: '46635646F54A: 46A39C'); the pieces' combined width must fit, which lint.py does not see: keep attack/action names short

item_list_name.evidence: items_owned: name sprites start x=96, the BG 'x' column at x=184 (tools/debug/namefields.py, work/qa/namefields/items_owned); 19+ bytes corrupt VRAM (work/qa/stress_19), 18 ok (work/qa/stress_18); ruler clipped by the x (work/qa/scenes_mfull/items_owned)

shop_part_name.evidence: parts_shop_list1: name x=16, BG 'x' at x~98 (work/qa/stress/z.png: 'Medabot Medal' fits, 16 chars run under the x); parts_shop_detail shows the name in a 10-cell box ('468411: Th', work/qa/scenes_m3) and goes black with an 18-byte ruler (work/qa/scenes_mfull, run 2): 10 bytes

medabot_name_box.evidence: robattle_prep / robattle / party3_setup: Medabot name sprites x=8..87, 10 cells (the nickname buffer is 10 bytes, padded); an 18-byte ruler broke the robattle_attack warp (work/qa/scenes_mfull, first run)
medabot_name_box.notes: player nicknames come from name entry (graphics/name-entry work, phase 6+)

tutorial_topic.evidence: field_help: rows from x=47, bar border at x~196; the 18-byte ruler (132 px) fits whole (work/qa/fh_z.png). Hard cap: phase 9 tried a 21-byte title (104 px) and its tail spilled into the row above ('Charge & Cooldowry', work/qa/topics9/p2cmp.png), so the row tile budget is per byte, not per px

credits_line.evidence: credits: 18-byte rulers (131 px) drawn whole and centred (work/qa/scenes_mfull/credits); wider is untested (re-measure before using more)

name_box_10.evidence: 10-byte rulers (66-68 px) drawn whole in ~80 px boxes: medal name (robattle_prep), skill type + action (parts_shop_detail blue boxes x=8..88), opponent name and terrain (robattle_intro/robattle_win info box), leg type (parts_legs_detail, the skill-type box: work/qa/wg/three2.png),work/qa/scenes_mfull + work/qa/psd.png, work/qa/mfull_pick2.png; 10 bytes x 8 px = 80 is the cap's own limit

battle_menu.evidence: robattle_menutour (scenes.txt; work/qa/wg/tc_sheet.png): all 6 entries cycle through the one blue box at the bottom right; 10-byte rulers (68 px advance, ink x=166..231) fill it to its inner edge x=232 (work/qa/wg/bm_z.png)

battle_status_box.evidence: robattle_parts (command menu > parts): the teal box under the H/R/L picker shows a 46F0BC entry; the 10-byte ruler (68 px) is centred in an 85 px inner area x=77..161 (work/qa/wg/bp_z.png)
battle_status_box.notes: the same table is also copied into message pieces (0x08017E5A -> 0x030005C6), which allow more; the box is the smaller budget

var_piece.evidence: code: the table's entries are strcpy'd (0x08040A4C / 0x08043294) into the F9 n piece buffers at 0x030005C6 + 20*n (0x0801D8F6, 0x08021582, 0x08025C10 part slots; 0x0801EC4E weapon kinds; 0x08017E8C attack names; 0x0800F60C model codes), so 19 bytes + terminator before the next buffer. On screen: the original's battle line 'うつこうどう レーザー!' (work/qa/wg/atkjp_msg.png, robattle_attack f6320) = action piece + weapon-kind piece in the 208 px battle box; the marker build draws a 10-byte piece ruler inline whole (work/qa/wg/three3.png)
var_piece.notes: px is a share of the 208 px battle line, not a box edge: two pieces (2 x 100) leave no room for the connector, so keep pieces that share a line short (action + weapon kind ~ 70 px each). Lines containing {var:01}-{var:04} are linted with each var at 100 px

page_tables.about: tables whose JP never uses {page} (FC) but where an English {page} is allowed (tools/lint.py page_problem). FC's wait for A is inside the text runner (0x0804123A calls 0x08041A28 and keeps the read offset until it returns 1), so a box the runner ticks until {end} with A as the advance key pages. One-shot {fa:FF} panes (parts_shop_detail: only page 1 drawn, work/qa/pg_psd/final.png) and timed battle lines are never allowed
